ud_dawn_watch: Watcher Kaelen Mornstride. You have come down the Frostward Descent, and this ledge is the Hollow Dawn - the north end of the Crystalline Underdark. Everything you can see below is one cavern. Kael's Bastion, where the expedition lives, is in the middle of it. Follow the path down and south.
ud_dawn_cartographer: Surveyor Aelwyn, of the Crimson Codex. I map the cavern from the Hollow Dawn because it is the only place high enough to see the far wall. The light you can see is the Lumen, in the roof. It does not reach the south-west corner, and we call that part the Dim Reaches.
ud_lattice_surveyor: Surveyor Pelorien. This is the Lattice, in the north-east of the cavern. The crystal here grows in exact repeating figures, which rock does not do. The Codex has told me to record it as unusual mineral growth. I have, and I do not believe it.
ud_shard_harvester: Delvin Brightsunder, harvester. These are the Shardfields, on the west side of the cavern, and I cut crystal here for the Bastion. It is hard on the hands and the eyes. The crawlers that live in the shards have been getting bolder.
ud_sporefall_forager: Mikael, forager. This is the Sporefall, in the middle of the cavern just south of the Bastion gate. I gather the fungus that is safe to eat and feed the expedition with it. The caps are safe and the stalks are not. I found that out myself.
ud_marsh_naturalist: Naturalist Imrelle. This is the Lumen Marsh, on the east side of the cavern. The water here is lit from below, and the light pulses in time with the Lumen in the roof. I have been measuring it for a year and I cannot yet tell you why.
ud_colonnade_scholar: Scholar Veridan. These pillars are the Weeping Colonnade, south of the Bastion. The masonry is Dalaran work - I trained there and I know it. It is far underground, in a cavern that has only existed for three years, and nobody carried it down here.
ud_bloom_warden: Bloom-Warden Ysolde Emberquill. The cave behind me is the Deep Bloom, in the south-west of the cavern. Something is growing down there in the shape of a library, with shelves and pages. The Codex-Master wants it read. I think it should be burned before it finishes.
ud_archive_overseer: Overseer Thaleon Greyquill. This dig is the Sunken Archive, in the south-east corner of the cavern. It is a buried library, and it is the reason the expedition was sent. It is also dangerous - the dead who kept it are still inside.
ud_archive_digger: Sarenne, digger at the Sunken Archive. I move rock and the scholars file what comes out. Last week I dug up a tablet with a Codex catalogue number on it - one we have not issued yet. Nobody will tell me what that means.
ud_dim_scout: Scout Rhennik. Past this ridge are the Dim Reaches, the south-west corner of the cavern, where the Lumen does not reach. I scout it for the Bastion. Things live out there that never come into the light, and I have only seen them while running.
